USOS uses the unmodified DOS Patcher9x 0.9.91 release by JHRobotics.
The RAM patch incorporated in that project is by Rudolph R. Loew.
Upstream: https://github.com/JHRobotics/patcher9x/releases/tag/v0.9.91
The corresponding Patcher9x sources, including libmspack and its license,
are provided in source.zip. See LICENSE.TXT for the Patcher9x MIT license.

CWSDPMI release 7 is Copyright (C) 1995-2010 Charles W. Sandmann.
Its executable is redistributed unmodified under the binary redistribution
permission in CWSDPMI.TXT. Users have the right to receive its source code
and binary updates. Sources: https://www.delorie.com/pub/djgpp/current/v2misc/csdpmi7s.zip
Author's site: http://sandmann.dotster.com/cwsdpmi/

INSTALL.BAT and REPAIR.BAT are USOS integration scripts. They select only
the memory patch and disable CWSDPMI disk swapping.
